title: Mato Grosso planning secretariat's attendance system unavailable; secretariat denies an intrusion
date_note: Both articles are dated 23 November and describe the outage as happening that Monday.
org: Secretaria de Estado de Planejamento e Gestão (Seplag), Mato Grosso
geo_basis: state capital, seat of the state government; the articles do not name a city
summary: Gazeta Digital and Folhamax report that the Mato Grosso state attendance system Sigpass and Seplag's systems were down on Monday 23 November, and Folhamax says staff were released to work from home. Folhamax headlines it as a new hacker incident. Gazeta Digital's updated article says Seplag confirmed unavailability but denied any intrusion, citing a brief network connectivity outage.
plain: A Mato Grosso state attendance system was down on Monday. One report headlines it as a hacker incident; the planning secretariat says it was a network connectivity problem.
exec: A Brazilian state government system was unavailable; the secretariat denies an intrusion, so the cause is disputed.
impact: Seplag staff were released to work from home, per Folhamax.

validation.note: Gazeta Digital and Folhamax carry the same article by the same reporter, so they count as one publisher. Seplag's denial is as quoted by Gazeta Digital; the Seplag note was not read directly.

review.note: Compared title, date, outage category, Sigpass and Seplag down, home office, Seplag denial and network-connectivity wording against Gazeta Digital and Folhamax; Folhamax republishes Gazeta so single_source is right
